[Review #513](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/513#issuecomment-6844063713) completed its checks, but reviewer permissions blocked its required repository output.
It reports no major finding and one minor issue: the comparison self-check rewrites its saved record.
I checked four current file hashes against the saved preparation hashes. All matched.
I did not repeat the review probes or inspect the review artifact.

I corrected the [shaper skill](../execution/roles/orchestrator/SKILL.md): request format, reviewer output paths and report-marker check.
These changes aim to prevent another blocked output, missing request or rejected Finish. Reviewer permissions stay unchanged.
I prepared one [Owner request](requests.json) for eight public example VIs and their authoring record.
The request does not block other ready work. Owner agreement and example availability remain unconfirmed.
The layer check returned no errors. Saved output checks passed. [Policy orders](orders.json) contain no tasks.

Native runs, agent comparisons, independent native answers and withheld writing cases remain missing.
Isolation and artifact, version and hardware coverage remain incomplete. Tool quality is unmeasured; benchmark readiness remains unestablished.

## What next

[Working memory](../policy/working-memory.md#pair-tool-review-and-iteration-0103) preserves the findings, artifact hash and continuation steps.
The next shaper checks request publication and selects ready work. Import the review artifact only if a repository record is needed.
Verify its availability, hash and file pins first. Do not repeat completed probes to repair the output-path error.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
